title: Learning Module — The Crews Behind a Big Build

meta.hostNotes: The SmartCiti.X side of the flow contract only (docs/flowhub.md): generated by tools/gen_cg_units.mjs from the station's own steps and check; nothing here states how Cognition.X or any other host stores or presents it.

nodes.title: Check question — The Crews Behind a Big Build
nodes.why: One question on the idea just taught. A missed answer goes to a simpler re-teach step, then back here. Never scored against anyone.

check.q: A forklift beeps as it reverses across the training bay with a pallet. What do you do?
options: Step onto the marked walkway and wait until the forklift has passed.
check.why: A reversing beep means a machine is backing up and the driver's view is limited.

Put the stages of the build in order.
